description:
Initialization only: Simulated Annealing (SA).
- Initial Order: Ascending task IDs.
- Move: Random task removal and insertion at a random position.
- Acceptance: Always accept non-worse trials; accept worse trials with Metropolis probability exp(delta / T).
- Cooling & Termination: Cool geometrically after each trial; stop at evaluation limit or if <2 tasks. Return best issued trial.
